mainEntity.name: How do I extract only some pages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Type just the pages you want, like 2–4, 9. Pages that are not in any range are left out.

mainEntity.name: Can I split a PDF to fit an email attachment limit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose By file size and enter the limit, for example 10 MB for many email services. Each part is kept under that size.

mainEntity.name: How do I save every page as its own PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose One per page. You get a ZIP with one PDF for each page.
